description: Create a tracked link to a store, optionally to one specific page of it (a product or category URL on the store's own site). Use the store id from search_stores.

pageUrl.description: A page on that store's website to land on

store.description: Store id (goSlug) from search_stores, or a store name

sub.description: Your own user or session id, shown back in your Feedico click and sales reports (letters, digits, _ . : - only; never an e-mail)

name: get_store_link
title: Get a tracked link to a store page
